purpose: Current-project private identity, protection, ownership and state isolation.
use: Before reading or writing private state, or when the project or working directory changes: establish project identity, private layout and runtime isolation.
semantic_conditions: Private state belongs to exactly one project/workspace; runtime-owned and common scopes stay separate.
mandatory_preconditions: Discovered project root, protected private root and resolved owned/common locators.
postconditions_verification: No cross-project reuse; ambiguous ownership preserved and dependent use blocked.
